title: Ars Additions Codex Recipes
description: adds recipes for each tier of codex as well as a simple dupe recipe. feel free to delete the dupe recipe if you don't want it.
body: This mod adds recipes for the three tiers of codex items in Ars Additions. It also includes recipes for duplicating the codex items, so if you don't want to use those feel free to delete them from the mod folder.
